workflows.title: Descriptor layout check
workflows.decision: Review binary layout and selected configuration agreement using native elaboration/compiler facts and explicit intent.
intent_questions: Which hardware/software consumer contract defines logical fields, physical storage, offsets, byte order and alignment?
Which resolved native type and compiler ABI observations correspond to the actual consumed configuration?

evidence_roles.meaning: Original independently required behavior, objective or acceptance contract
Actual selected revision, configuration, mode and native tool/model basis
Original native observations and outcomes for the selected engineering question
Source-backed logical-to-native entity and population relationships

revalidate_when: Original requirement, applicability, exclusion rationale or receiving decision changes
Selected native entity, source, configuration, mode, tool/model version or extraction method changes
A dependent relationship or observation premise is changed, missing or contradicted

workflows.title: Configuration semantic consistency
workflows.decision: Review configuration semantic consistency through existing correction, handoff and revalidation.
intent_questions: Which independently required semantic parameters, units, defaults and overrides define this configuration handoff?
Which actual resolved hardware and compiled software facts support the declared transformation and original selected-role population?
